summarize_dataset_info: summarize the MPII dataset_info dictionary containing 16 keypoints, 15 skeleton links, joint weights, and sigmas
review_keypoint_info: review the keypoint_info dict defining 16 human body keypoints with names, colors, types, and swap pairs
review_skeleton_info: review the skeleton_info dict defining 15 bone links connecting keypoints for the MPII skeleton
review_joint_weights: review the joint_weights list assigning importance values to each of the 16 MPII keypoints
review_sigmas: review the sigmas list containing PCK tolerance thresholds adapted from the COCO dataset
